tools.name: trendsfast_global_trends
tools.description: Query the shared saved trend index without Product DNA. Maximum 1 credit(s); zero provider calls. Results rank explicit popularity or measured growth first, then US, UK, Canada and Australia, then Europe, alternating sources. data.brief groups the items into trending now, audience conversations, cre

tools.name: trendsfast_niche_trends
tools.description: Rank evidence against confirmed project context or explicit temporary niche. Without product: maximum 3 credits and no new source research. A product needs the confirmed context_id: it first collects the brand's own sources fresh, then ranks through that product's lens: customers (Customers) 10 cred

tools.name: trendsfast_discover_trends
tools.description: Answer one question across global, core and adjacent scope and every source channel in a single call. Maximum 5 credits; zero provider calls. Global scope needs no Product DNA. A channel with no permitted observation is reported UNAVAILABLE rather than empty. Saves a result and may debit credits. No

tools.name: trendsfast_ask_trends
tools.description: Answer a bounded question using saved intelligence. Maximum 5 credits. Questions about competitors, customer complaints, feature requests, hooks and formats, or search keywords each need their own evidence: answer_status says ANSWERED, PARTIAL, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, NEEDS_CONTEXT or NOT_COLLECTED,

tools.name: trendsfast_read_result
tools.description: Read a saved result, page it on next_cursor, or recover an exact accepted request ID. No credit debit or research. Source permissions, retention and context are rechecked.

tools.name: trendsfast_project_context
tools.description: Read the connected project name, ID and current confirmed niche context, or an explicit missing-context state. Returns the context_id that niche and Ask queries accept. No credit debit, context mutation or new research.

tools.name: trendsfast_credit_balance
tools.description: Read the shared REST/MCP credit balance, monthly/prepaid split, reservations and pause state without spending credits.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "trendsfast_niche_trends" is 2073 chars, far longer than this server's median (321). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
